note: Survivor testimonies from the Kwibuka memorial.

testimonies.title: Testimony of a Genocide Survivor from Rwanda
testimonies.summary: Survived alone for two months at age nine during the 1994 genocide against the Tutsi. Hidden by a neighbor in a small space, she endured extreme hardship before being rescued.

testimonies.title: She Hid in a Bathroom For 91 Days
testimonies.summary: Immaculée Ilibagiza's account of surviving the 1994 genocide by hiding in a small bathroom with seven other women for 91 days.

testimonies.title: Survivor Testimony - Kigali
testimonies.summary: Personal account of survival during the 1994 genocide against the Tutsi in Kigali.

testimonies.title: Testimony from Southern Province
testimonies.summary: Testimony of a survivor from the Southern Province, detailing the events of April-July 1994.

testimonies.title: Orphaned by the Genocide
testimonies.summary: Two orphans share their experiences of losing their families during the genocide and their journey to survival.

testimonies.title: Survivor Testimony - Butare
testimonies.summary: Account of survival in Butare during the genocide, including experiences at the university campus.

testimonies.title: Women Survivors of the Genocide
testimonies.summary: Collective testimony from women survivors discussing their experiences and the impact of the genocide on women and girls.

testimonies.title: Child Survivor Testimony
testimonies.summary: Testimony of a child who survived the genocide, detailing their experiences as a young orphan.

testimonies.title: Survivor Testimony - Nyamata
testimonies.summary: Testimony from a survivor of the Nyamata church massacre, one of the most tragic sites of the genocide.

testimonies.title: Rescue and Survival
testimonies.summary: Account of being rescued by a Rwandan family during the genocide and surviving in hiding.

testimonies.title: Survivor Testimony - Murambi
testimonies.summary: Testimony from a survivor of the Murambi technical school massacre.

testimonies.title: Lost and Found: A Family's Story
testimonies.summary: Story of a family separated during the genocide and their journey to reunite years later.

testimonies.title: Survivor Testimony - Bisesero
testimonies.summary: Testimony from the Bisesero region, known for the resistance and survival of many Tutsi during the genocide.

testimonies.title: Healing and Remembrance
testimonies.summary: Discussion with survivors about the process of healing, remembrance, and building a better future for Rwanda.
